_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6 / Phase MG). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1): it ships a clamped tempo-heuristic fallback and reads THIS file at runtime for the real genre feel. Zero-rebuild to tune. Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift.
name: Soul
blurb: Motown / Stax soul: a ghost-note backbeat pocket, rootless Rhodes 7th/9th voicings, and a melodic finger bass.

flavors.label: Motown Drive
flavors.blurb: Bright I-vi-ii-V with chopped piano eighths and tambourine -- singable, mostly triads.

flavors.label: Stax Grease
flavors.blurb: Memphis sparse: two chords, plain triads, everybody dragging just behind the backbeat.

flavors.label: Church Vamp
flavors.blurb: Take it to church -- one chord, hands clapping, organ riding the shout chorus.

flavors.label: Deep Soul Ballad
flavors.blurb: Slow and sustained, organ pads swelling under a borrowed minor iv on the way home.

flavors.label: Philly Sweet
flavors.blurb: Gamble and Huff lush: maj9s moving every two bars, strings on top, machine-smooth.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Soul harmony is diatonic and singable: I-vi-ii-V turnarounds, I-IV-ii-V gospel lifts, and long i-bVII minor vamps. Color comes from Rhodes and organ 7ths and 9ths, a secondary III7 pushing to IV, and a borrowed minor iv on the way home. Changes move every two bars, land on the backbeat, and always resolve.
